name: knowledge-first-reuse-gate
purpose: Existing local assets, collected repositories, and the pinned Top Five are the primary search space before new external research.
rules: Inspect user project and storage repositories without mixing their state.
Inspect Project-/COLLECTION before new web or GitHub research.
Inspect the pinned Top Five next.
Prefer reuse or adaptation over greenfield implementation.
If a capability exists but is not integrated, integrate it before searching for a replacement.
Documentation is discovery evidence only; runtime availability requires authorization, reachability, operation testing, and independent verification.
External research is allowed only when the existing corpus cannot satisfy the missing capability or freshness is required.
Keep credentials, secrets, state, revenue evidence, and deployment evidence isolated by project.

decisionRecord.stopCondition: Stop searching when an existing evidence-backed capability satisfies the requirement and can be integrated safely.
